qualifier: formation and fusion, not lipolysis or lipophagy
name: Lipid droplet formation and fusion
rationale: All three members concern building and organizing lipid droplets (formation, fusion, organization), whereas confusables cover droplet disassembly/lipophagy, triglyceride synthesis or LXR-driven lipid gene regulation.

qualifier: sweet, umami, bitter and salty via class C taste receptors, not sour or smell
name: Sweet, umami, bitter and salty taste perception
rationale: Members are taste detection pathways for sweet, umami, bitter and salty plus the class C GPCRs (T1R) that mediate sweet/umami, while confusables centre on sour taste, acid-sensing channels or olfaction.

core: Restraint of type I interferon and PKR signaling
qualifier: ADAR adenosine-to-inosine RNA editing
name: ADAR A-to-I RNA editing restraining interferon and PKR
rationale: Members combine ADAR editosome/A-to-I deamination with negative regulation of type I IFN and PKR kinase signaling, the editing arm being what separates the theme from interferon-response and TLR7/8/9 confusables.

qualifier: influenza and RSV transcription, RNP assembly and nuclear transport
name: Influenza and RSV genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover influenza vRNP/vRNA synthesis, nuclear import/export and RSV genome transcription, replication and virion assembly, distinguishing it from confusables focused on viral mRNA translation, host-shutoff and coronavirus replication.

qualifier: ER store release and store-operated entry, membrane potential, non-cardiac
name: Cytosolic Ca2+ control by ER release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic Ca2+ through sequestered-store release, ryanodine channels, store-operated entry, exchangers and resting potential (incl. skeletal T-tubules), while confusables are framed around cardiac contraction and SERCA/heart-rate regulation.

core: Epithelial lineage differentiation in branched organs
qualifier: distal lung pneumocyte and pancreatic lineages
name: Distal lung epithelial and pancreatic lineage differentiation
rationale: Members centre on lung saccule/pneumocyte/bronchial epithelial maturation with pancreatic ductal and endocrine progenitor lineages and terminal-unit branching, distinguishing it from mammary, prostate, salivary and kidney nephron development confusables.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription and mitoribosome translation
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability and mitoribosome assembly/translation, whereas confusables focus on mitochondrial and nuclear tRNA processing and RNA import.

qualifier: ADA/PNP degradation of (deoxy)nucleosides, not salvage
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleoside and nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown of AMP, IMP, dGMP, adenosine, inosine and deoxypurines via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, distinguished from purine salvage/de novo synthesis confusables and pyrimidine deoxynucleotide catabolism.

core: Regulation of osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 and BMP signaling input
name: TGF-beta/BMP control of osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor expansion
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation with TGF-beta2, SMAD2/3, BMP and Wnt signaling, whereas confusables emphasize ossification, mineralization, chondrocyte and osteoclast processes.

qualifier: node of Ranvier assembly and peripheral Schwann cell myelin
name: Node of Ranvier assembly and peripheral axon myelination
rationale: Members cover neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin interactions, sodium channel clustering, paranodal junctions and Schwann cell (PNS) myelination, separating it from CNS myelin and general L1/CHL1 adhesion confusables.

qualifier: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling
name: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling
rationale: Members regulate Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13 production and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling in anti-nematode responses, whereas confusables centre on mast cell FcERI/degranulation, eosinophils or IgE switching.

qualifier: selective cargo autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members span cargo-selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, micro- and chaperone-mediated) and regulation of autophagosome assembly/maturation, whereas confusables cover lysosome fusion, aggresomes or ESCRT/MVB.

qualifier: bicarbonate/acid-base and phosphate transporters and their disorders
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and other inorganic anion transport
rationale: Members are transport of bicarbonate, phosphate, sulfate, oxalate and iodide (SLC4, SLC26, SLC34, SLC20) with pH regulation and transporter-defect diseases, unlike confusables on enamel mineralization or organelle acidification.

qualifier: deadenylation, decapping and 3'-UTR binding proteins
name: mRNA decay and stabilization by 3'-UTR binding proteins
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay plus ARE/3'-UTR binders (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR, IGF2BPs), distinct from miRNA silencing, stress granule and nuclear 3'-end processing confusables.

qualifier: docking, priming and SNARE assembly before calcium-triggered fusion
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered fusion
rationale: Members concern vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and Ca2+-dependent/spontaneous fusion, whereas confusables are transmitter-specific release cycles or broader presynaptic plasticity.

qualifier: GAP/NF1 control and pathogenic RAS and MAP2K mutants
name: RAS-MAPK signaling with GAP control and pathogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover RAS signal regulation, RAS GAPs/NF1 loss, oncogenic RAS and MAP2K mutants and downstream RSK/p38 outputs, distinguishing it from confusables on SOS/SHC activation, ERK feedback or RAF/MRAS complexes.

qualifier: forebrain progenitors and neuron versus glia fate
name: Forebrain neural progenitor proliferation and neuron-glia fate choice
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/ventricular-zone progenitor division, stem cell maintenance and neuronal versus astrocyte/oligodendrocyte/Schwann fates, unlike confusables on midbrain, cerebellar, sympathetic or pituitary development.

qualifier: with lysophospholipid hydrolysis, not de novo synthesis
name: Glycerophospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members are Lands-cycle remodeling of PC, PE, PS, PI and PG plus LPC/LPE hydrolysis, distinguishing them from de novo phospholipid/cardiolipin synthesis, sphingolipid and endocannabinoid confusables.

qualifier: refolding plus aggresome formation and aggrephagy
name: Chaperone protein folding, refolding and aggresome clearance
rationale: Members cover de novo, ER and chaperone-assisted folding, unfolding/refolding and aggresome assembly/aggrephagy, whereas confusables focus on CCT/TriC chaperonin folding or ubiquitin/CMA degradation of misfolded proteins.

qualifier: VLDL assembly and VLDL/chylomicron clearance, not remodeling
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and VLDL assembly
rationale: Members are VLDL assembly and clearance of VLDL and chylomicrons, whereas confusables cover lipoprotein remodeling, HDL/LDL handling and lipase activation.

qualifier: compartment-specific PIP synthesis and phosphatase regulation
name: Phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate interconversion across membranes
rationale: Members are synthesis of PIPs at each organelle membrane and of soluble inositol phosphates plus regulation of phosphoinositide dephosphorylation, unlike confusables on ER lipid transfer, membrane contact sites and Golgi traffic.

qualifier: PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signaling
name: cAMP-PKA and AMPK regulation of triglyceride turnover
rationale: Members link glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK-ChREBP signaling to triglyceride catabolism and reduced triglyceride synthesis, while confusables address glycogen, gluconeogenesis, ChREBP activation or LXR lipid genes.

qualifier: glycerolipid synthesis with lipid droplet formation and turnover
name: Triglyceride synthesis and lipid droplet storage dynamics
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/TAG synthesis and lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy in adipocyte fat storage, whereas confusables emphasize triglyceride catabolism, PDE3B signaling or phospholipid regulation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III mechanics plus snRNA genes
name: Pol I and Pol III transcription of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA
rationale: Members are initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I and III (rRNA, 5S, tRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA transcription, unlike confusables on rRNA processing, rDNA chromatin regulation or snRNP/histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: CFTR-mediated anion and fluid secretion, pancreatic duct
name: Apical membrane trafficking and CFTR-mediated epithelial fluid secretion
rationale: Members combine apical/raft protein localization and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport with CFTR trafficking, anion and transepithelial water transport in pancreatic ductal epithelium, unlike flippase/bile, TRP channel or tight-junction confusables.
